failure_discovery.claim_scope: 可复现失败仅限冻结的 Mamba-130M checkpoint、structured_repetitive、red/blue 值对与 Round18 协议；Pythia 是配对行为参考，不是架构因果控制。

causal_diagnosis.approved_claim: Under structured-repetition remote-memory stress conditions, Mamba-130M recurrent state content causally influences remote-memory behavior.

causal_diagnosis.claim_scope: 仅限 Mamba-130M、结构化重复远程记忆压力和已测试值对；不外推到所有 SSM、任务、值对或长上下文失败。

transfer_surface.claim_scope: 这些结果证明 StateFuzz 可迁移到更广压力族、受控现实任务和指定 Hybrid checkpoint；后期 surface cohort 零 failure boundary 仅适用于其自身协议切片。

differing_protocol_fields.source_a: seeds 29-44; structured_repetitive; red/blue; budgets 256-1920 including 1792; ±16; Mamba 12/16 failures at 1792
differing_protocol_fields.source_b: historical seeds 61-62 and Zamba2 seeds 69-72; multiple stress families; sparse/different budgets; later packaging reports zero observed boundaries

apparent_conflicts.permitted_wording: Round18 发现冻结 structured-repetition failure regime；后期 transfer/surface cohort 在各自观测范围内没有 failure boundary。

differing_protocol_fields.observed: 按 architecture role 分组的 checkpoint 呈现不同描述性 margin profiles
differing_protocol_fields.uncontrolled: scale, training data, instruction tuning, seeds, tolerance and checkpoint identity

apparent_conflicts.permitted_wording: 架构角色分组的已测试 checkpoint 呈现不同响应；不声称差异由架构因果造成。

differing_protocol_fields.source_a: Mamba-130M native recurrent-state override under a frozen failure condition with correct/wrong/random controls
differing_protocol_fields.source_b: Zamba2 Hybrid body-cache replay and path swap; Round33 reconstruction valid rate 0/40 versus required 90%

apparent_conflicts.permitted_wording: Mamba-130M recurrent-state causal evidence remains valid in its frozen condition; invalid Zamba2 replay blocks only Hybrid internal SSM-vs-Attention attribution.

resolved_interpretations: Failure discovery, causal diagnosis, transfer surfaces, and mitigation answer different questions and must not be collapsed into one cohort.
Zero observed failure boundaries in Round35/36 are negative evidence for those later protocol slices, not a project-wide zero-failure result.
Cross-checkpoint contrasts are behavioral and descriptive unless scale, training, tuning, seed, and tolerance confounds are controlled.
A failed Hybrid cache reconstruction protocol does not retroactively invalidate native Mamba recurrent-state intervention evidence.
paper_mainline: Round18 failure discovery and paired Pythia behavioral contrast
Round20/21 Mamba recurrent-state causal diagnosis and fresh-seed replication
Round25/27/31/34/35/36 transfer to broader stresses, realistic tasks, and Zamba2
paper_secondary: Round28 context-anchor mitigation as task-specific evidence
Round35/36 full descriptive stress surfaces and missing-budget coverage
excluded_claims: all SSMs have the same failure boundary
Mamba is globally worse than Pythia
Hybrid SSM-vs-Attention path attribution is established
zero failures in Round35/36 imply no failures elsewhere
causal intervention results apply to all value pairs, tasks, checkpoints, or models
any mitigation strategy is universally beneficial
